## What it checks (sampled describe/it titles)

- CADWeldmentEngine — structural members / gussets / fillet weld-beads
- member: volume = section_area * length (400mm^2 x 1000mm = 400000)
- gusset: volume = 0.5 * a * b * t (50x50x6 = 7500)
- weld_bead: equal-leg fillet, volume = 0.5*leg^2*length (leg6 len100 = 1800), throat = leg/sqrt2
- member: a different section/length (200x500 = 100000)
- weld_bead: leg 8 length 250 -> 0.5*64*250 = 8000
